items.title: Jim Cullum interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: We had Sweets Edison on the show one time and he told a story about playing with Basie

ctx.x: Yeah. You’ve got to arrange it a little bit more.

Arrange it a little more. And sometimes they didn’t have any music, you just go with what you can sort of listen for another harmony note. We had Sweets Edison on the show one time and he told a story about playing with Basie and he says he went into Basie and he says, “I’m frustrated” he says, “I’m going to have to give my notice.” And so Basie says, “Why, you sound real good,” he says, “what’s the problem?” He says, “I can’t find a note, I can’t find a note.” There was all the other guys that had all the notes…
